mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 1.5% is associated with negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 4.5% signals labor market deterioration, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises above 4.5% in 3 months, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicate robust aggregate demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns through multiplicative demand effects.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the interaction term coefficient is negative with p>0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a deceleration in industrial production (INDPRO) signals economic weakening, driving negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO growth rate falls below 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, INDPRO growth below 0.5% in 3 months is associated with positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL rise above 2.5% annually signals inflationary pressures, prompting monetary tightening and driving negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL rises above 2.5% in 3 months, 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Nonfarm payrolls growth exceeding 150,000 per month signals a strong labor market, supporting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth rate exceeds 150,000 in 3 months
failure_condition: When PAYEMS growth exceeds 150,000 in 3 months, 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth above 2.5% signals strong economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: When quarterly GDP growth exceeds 2.5%, 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate rise above 2.0% signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and driving negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS rises above 2.0% in 3 months, 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.03.
